en.name: root
en.definition: The core letters, usually three, shared by a family of related words. For example ر ح م (mercy) gives رَحْمَٰن, رَحِيم and رَحْمَة.

en.name: lemma
en.definition: The dictionary form of a word: the basic form you would look up, before prefixes, suffixes and endings are added.

en.name: prefix
en.definition: A letter or short particle joined to the front of a word, such as وَ (and), بِ (in, with) or ال (the).

en.name: suffix
en.definition: A letter or short form joined to the end of a word, most often an attached pronoun such as هُمْ (them) or نَا (us).

en.name: noun
en.definition: A word that names a person, thing, place, quality or idea. Arabic nouns carry case endings that show their role in the sentence.

en.name: verb
en.definition: A word that expresses an action or state. Its form changes for tense, person, gender and number.

en.name: proper noun
en.definition: The name of a specific person, place or being, such as اللَّه, مُوسَى or مَكَّة.

en.name: pronoun
en.definition: A word that stands in for a noun: a separate word such as هُوَ (he), or an ending attached to a verb, noun or particle.

en.name: demonstrative
en.definition: A word that points to something, such as هَٰذَا (this) or ذَٰلِكَ (that).

en.name: relative pronoun
en.definition: A word such as الَّذِي (who, which) or مَا (what) that links a noun to a clause describing it.

en.name: adverb of time
en.definition: A noun used to say when something happens, such as يَوْمَ (on the day) or إِذْ (when).

en.name: adverb of place
en.definition: A noun used to say where something is, such as عِنْدَ (with, at) or تَحْتَ (beneath).

en.name: verb-like noun
en.definition: A word that is a noun in form but works like a verb, such as هَيْهَاتَ (how far!) or أُفٍّ (ugh!).

en.name: conditional noun
en.definition: A noun that introduces a condition, such as مَنْ (whoever) or مَا (whatever).

en.name: interrogative noun
en.definition: A noun used to ask a question, such as مَنْ (who?), مَا (what?) or كَيْفَ (how?).

en.name: preposition
en.definition: A particle such as فِي (in), مِنْ (from) or بِ (with) that puts the noun after it in the genitive case.

en.name: definite article
en.definition: The prefix ال (the), which makes a noun definite.

en.name: coordinating conjunction
en.definition: A particle such as وَ (and), فَ (then, so) or ثُمَّ (then) that joins words or clauses of equal standing.

en.name: resumption particle
en.definition: A particle, usually وَ or فَ, that starts a new sentence rather than joining it to the previous one.

en.name: subordinating particle
en.definition: A particle such as أَنْ (that) that turns the clause after it into the equivalent of a verbal noun.

en.name: accusative particle
en.definition: A particle such as إِنَّ (indeed) or أَنَّ (that) that puts the noun after it in the accusative case, or puts the verb after it in the subjunctive mood.

en.name: negative particle
en.definition: A particle such as لَا, لَمْ, لَنْ or مَا that negates what follows it.

en.name: emphatic lām
en.definition: The prefix لَ used to emphasise a statement (surely, indeed).

en.name: imperative lām
en.definition: The prefix لِ placed before an imperfect verb to give a command (let him …). The verb becomes jussive.

en.name: purpose lām
en.definition: The prefix لِ placed before a verb to express purpose (in order to, so that).

en.name: conditional particle
en.definition: A particle such as إِنْ (if), لَوْ (if only) or إِذَا (when) that introduces a condition.

en.name: interrogative particle
en.definition: A particle such as أَ or هَلْ that turns a sentence into a question.

en.name: vocative particle
en.definition: A particle such as يَا (O …!) used to call or address someone.

en.name: particle of certainty
en.definition: The particle قَدْ before a perfect verb, meaning that something has certainly happened.

en.name: restriction particle
en.definition: A particle such as إِلَّا after a negation, restricting a statement to one thing (none but …, only …).

en.name: retraction particle
en.definition: The particle بَلْ (rather, nay), which sets aside what came before in favour of what follows.

en.name: preventive particle
en.definition: The particle مَا attached to a word such as إِنَّ (إِنَّمَا), stopping it from affecting the case of what follows.

en.name: future particle
en.definition: The particle سَ or سَوْفَ before an imperfect verb, marking the future (will).

en.name: exceptive particle
en.definition: A particle such as إِلَّا (except) that excludes something from a general statement.

en.name: particle of cause
en.definition: The particle فَ when it introduces a result caused by what came before (so that, and so).

en.name: explanation particle
en.definition: The particle أَمَّا (as for), which introduces a detailed explanation.

en.name: amendment particle
en.definition: The particle لَٰكِنْ (but), which corrects or qualifies what came before.

en.name: answer particle
en.definition: A particle such as بَلَىٰ (yes indeed) or نَعَمْ (yes) used to answer.

en.name: inceptive particle
en.definition: A particle such as حَتَّىٰ or أَلَا that begins a new clause.

en.name: particle of interpretation
en.definition: The particle أَنْ when it explains the content of something said or commanded (namely, that is).

en.name: exhortation particle
en.definition: A particle such as لَوْلَا or هَلَّا urging someone to act (why not …?).

en.name: surprise particle
en.definition: The particle إِذَا expressing that something happened suddenly (and behold …).

en.name: aversion particle
en.definition: The particle كَلَّا (no indeed!), which rejects what came before.

en.name: result particle
en.definition: The particle فَ that begins the result clause of a condition (then …).

en.name: supplemental particle
en.definition: A particle that adds emphasis without changing the grammatical structure, such as مَا in فَبِمَا.

en.name: circumstantial particle
en.definition: The particle وَ introducing a clause that describes the circumstances of the action (while …).

en.name: prohibition particle
en.definition: The particle لَا before an imperfect verb in the jussive, forbidding an action (do not …).

en.name: equalization particle
en.definition: The particle أَ meaning it makes no difference whether … or ….

en.name: comitative wāw
en.definition: The particle وَ meaning together with, rather than and.

en.name: attention particle
en.definition: The particle هَا that draws attention, as at the start of هَٰذَا (this) or in يَٰٓأَيُّهَا (O you).

en.name: lām of distance
en.definition: The لِ inside ذَٰلِكَ (that) and similar words, marking something as further away.

en.name: addressee particle
en.definition: The كَ ending of words such as ذَٰلِكَ (that), showing who is being addressed.

en.name: disconnected letters
en.definition: Letters at the start of some surahs, such as الٓمٓ, read letter by letter. Their meaning is known only to Allah.

en.name: active participle
en.definition: A noun formed from a verb for the one who does the action, such as مَالِك (owner, master) from مَلَكَ (to own).

en.name: passive participle
en.definition: A noun formed from a verb for the one the action is done to, such as مَغْضُوب (one who earned anger) from غَضِبَ.

en.name: verbal noun
en.definition: A noun naming the action of a verb itself, such as هُدَى (guidance) from هَدَى (to guide).

en.name: adjective
en.definition: A noun that describes the noun before it and agrees with it in case, gender, number and definiteness.

en.name: indefinite
en.definition: A noun without ال or another marker of definiteness (a, an, some), usually ending in tanwīn.

en.name: nominative
en.definition: The case of a noun that is the subject or the topic of a sentence, typically marked with ـُ (ḍamma).

en.name: accusative
en.definition: The case of a noun that is the object of a verb, or follows particles such as إِنَّ, typically marked with ـَ (fatḥa).

en.name: genitive
en.definition: The case of a noun after a preposition, or the second noun in a possessive construction (the name of Allah), typically marked with ـِ (kasra).

en.name: perfect verb
en.definition: A verb for a completed action, usually translated with the past tense.

en.name: imperfect verb
en.definition: A verb for an ongoing, habitual or future action, usually translated with the present or future tense.

en.name: imperative verb
en.definition: A verb that gives a command or makes a request, such as ٱهْدِنَا (guide us).

en.name: passive voice
en.definition: The verb's subject receives the action instead of doing it, such as أُنزِلَ (was sent down).

en.name: indicative mood
en.definition: The ordinary mood of an imperfect verb for statements, typically ending in ـُ or ـونَ.

en.name: subjunctive mood
en.definition: The mood of an imperfect verb after particles such as أَنْ and لَنْ, typically ending in ـَ or losing its final نَ.

en.name: jussive mood
en.definition: The mood of an imperfect verb after لَمْ, in prohibitions and in conditions, typically ending in sukūn or losing its final نَ.

en.name: form I
en.definition: The basic verb pattern, built directly on the root.

en.name: form II
en.definition: Doubles the middle root letter. Often intensive or causative: to make someone do something.

en.name: form III
en.definition: Adds ا after the first root letter. Often means doing the action with or towards someone.

en.name: form IV
en.definition: Adds أَ before the root. Often causative: to cause something to happen, such as أَنزَلَ (to send down).

en.name: form V
en.definition: Adds تَ to form II. Often reflexive: to do the action to oneself, or gradually.

en.name: form VI
en.definition: Adds تَ to form III. Often reciprocal: to do the action to one another.

en.name: form VII
en.definition: Adds ان before the root. Usually passive or reflexive in meaning.

en.name: form VIII
en.definition: Adds ا before and ت after the first root letter. Often reflexive or doing the action for oneself.

en.name: form IX
en.definition: Doubles the last root letter. Used for colours and physical states, such as becoming black.

en.name: form X
en.definition: Adds است before the root. Often means seeking or asking for the action, such as نَسْتَعِينُ (we ask for help).

en.name: form XI
en.definition: A rare pattern, like form IX with a long vowel, used for intense colours and states.

en.name: first person
en.definition: The speaker: I or we.

en.name: second person
en.definition: The one spoken to: you.

en.name: third person
en.definition: The one spoken about: he, she, it or they.

en.name: masculine
en.definition: Grammatically masculine. Arabic marks gender on nouns, pronouns, adjectives and verbs.

en.name: feminine
en.definition: Grammatically feminine, often marked with ة (tā' marbūṭa) on nouns and ت on verbs.

en.name: singular
en.definition: One person or thing.

en.name: dual
en.definition: Exactly two. Arabic has special forms for two, such as ـَانِ and ـَيْنِ.

en.name: plural
en.definition: Three or more persons or things.

en.name: inna and its sisters
en.definition: Particles such as إِنَّ, أَنَّ, لَٰكِنَّ and لَعَلَّ. The noun after them becomes accusative and their predicate stays nominative.

en.name: kāna and its sisters
en.definition: Verbs such as كَانَ (was), أَصْبَحَ and لَيْسَ. Their subject stays nominative and their predicate becomes accusative.

en.name: kāda and its sisters
en.definition: Verbs of nearness and beginning, such as كَادَ (almost) and عَسَىٰ (perhaps), followed by an imperfect verb.
